stories.title: Jensen Huang’s exit puts Nvidia’s support for open source in question
stories.explanation: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned, raising questions about the company's commitment to open-source AI and its Hugging Face acquisition. Huang was a strong advocate for open-source AI, and his departure could impact the open model community.

stories.title: Introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen
stories.explanation: Google introduced Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a new fast and cost-efficient AI model built for reliable agentic workflows and everyday tasks. This model is now available across Google AI Studio, the Gemini API, Gemini for business, the Gemini app, Google Search, and Google Antigravity.

stories.title: Hugging Face CEO vows to keep fighting for open source AI after Jensen Huang’s exit
stories.explanation: Hugging Face CEO Clément Delangue vowed to continue fighting for open-source AI after Jensen Huang's exit from Nvidia, expressing sadness over the departure. This raises questions about Nvidia's $12.9 billion acquisition of Hugging Face and its future commitment to open source.

stories.title: AlphaGenome 2: Deciphering how cells read DNA to better understand disease
stories.explanation: Google DeepMind announced AlphaGenome 2, a next-generation DNA sequence model that predicts how genetic variants affect human cell types. This model provides a new tool for scientists to understand the cellular drivers of disease by bridging single-cell biology and human genetics.

stories.title: Taiwan’s chipmaking giant TSMC to invest $1B in Anthropic, OpenAI
stories.explanation: TSMC, a major chip manufacturer, plans to invest $1 billion in Anthropic and OpenAI, with $500 million in each company. This investment gives TSMC direct stakes in leading AI developers, even as its chipmaking business profits from the AI data center buildout.

stories.title: Supporting research on AI and children’s safety
stories.explanation: OpenAI committed $2 million to research on AI and children's safety, supporting a scientific research network under the Coalition for Children’s Rights and Protection in the Age of AI. This initiative aims to develop tools to measure AI's risks and opportunities for children, informing safer products and policies.

stories.title: Content Understanding adds GPT-6.1, 6, and 5.6: Choose the right model for your workload
stories.explanation: Azure Content Understanding now supports the GPT-5.6, GPT-6, and GPT-6.1 model families, offering more choices for document, text, speech, and video workflows. This expansion provides customers with greater flexibility to balance quality and cost for different AI workloads.

stories.title: From AI ambition to business impact
stories.explanation: Microsoft Frontier Company has engaged in nearly 500 AI projects with over 200 customers across 28 countries, helping businesses move from AI pilots to impactful operational changes. This highlights Microsoft's focus on driving real business value through AI adoption.

stories.title: Nebius tests the neocloud playbook with $40 billion in planned spending
stories.explanation: Nebius plans $40 billion in AI infrastructure spending by 2027, funded by customer prepayments and loans. This ambitious plan faces risks due to potential project delays and its reliance on future value.

stories.title: Nvidia privately confirmed it could track chips to fight smuggling, even as industry publicly questioned feasibility
stories.explanation: Nvidia privately confirmed to Representative Bill Foster that it is technically possible to implement anti-smuggling measures for AI chips, despite industry claims of infeasibility. This relates to proposed legislation for chip security.
